title: 第15章 好好修炼别给你爹丢人第16章 你这德性长得也太磕碜
slug: 玄幻穿成野狗生崽就能变强
lines: 林野趴在她身边，把鼻尖搭在她的肩头上。
“吃完等我回来，我去一趟横云山。把青河宗的窝端了。”
菀月停下咀嚼的动作，尾巴弯过来，轻轻搭在他的前爪上。
“别受伤。”
林野带着尖牙和十二只黑狼公狼连夜赶路。
横云山三座主峰并立，山腰云雾缭绕，峰顶建着错落的殿宇楼阁。
山门处一座石牌坊，上书青河宗三个大字。
林野的妖威裹着紫电气息，顺着山风直灌山门。
钟声在山腰响了三下，从殿宇楼阁中冲出来十几个弟子，清一色炼气期，脸上写满慌张。
一个看上去像管事弟子的中年人跑到山门前，抬头看了一眼，腿软了。
“快！启动宗门大阵！”
阵纹从山门地基下亮起，向三峰扩散。
石牌坊上的雷击石嗡嗡震动，是那颗据说只剩下三成威力的雷击石。
林野站在山门前五十步的位置，低头看着地上蔓延过来的阵纹。
一道紫色雷柱从天劈落，正中石牌坊。
百年法阵的阵纹崩裂，一路碎到山腰，灵光明灭了几下，熄了。
宗门大阵，没了。
林野迈步走上台阶。
身后，尖牙带着黑狼妖群呈扇形散开，把三峰之间所有的退路封死。
剩下的事情，没什么好说的。
炼气期的弟子连反抗的资格都没有。跑的也没跑出去，黑狼堵在各个要道上。
半个时辰后，横云山易主。
尖牙叼着一份从藏经阁翻出来的青河宗弟子名册跑过来，鼻子上沾着灰。
“大王，横云山内部三峰的密林和地下溶洞里，藏着大量妖兽。”
“有些是以前被抓来签了血契的灵兽，血契随主人死了就断了，还有些是横云山本地的野妖。”
“粗略估计，不下三百只，据估计，母兽不少，体质状态需要仔细调查。”
林野的耳朵竖了一下。
这比预想的收获大得多。但横云山离黑风山四百里，鞭长莫及。
“你留下，以后横云山的妖归你管。”
“母兽每三日饮灵泉水的规矩照搬，这里没有灵泉，就用灵脉渗出来的泉眼代替。”
“收编的妖兽照黑风山的山规来，不准伤人族幼童，违者你直接处置。”
尖牙的四条腿绷直了。
“属下领命！”
content_en:
Lin Ye lay beside her and rested his nose on her shoulder.
"Wait until I come back after eating. I'll go to Hengyun Mountain and pick up the Qinghe Sect's nest."
Wanyue stopped chewing, bent her tail, and gently rested it on his front paws.
"Don't get hurt."
Lin Ye took Jianfan and twelve male black wolves on the road overnight.
The three main peaks of Hengyun Mountain stand side by side. The mountainside is shrouded in clouds and mist, and there are scattered palaces and pavilions on the top of the peak.
There is a stone archway at the gate of the mountain with the three characters of Qinghe Sect written on it.
The demonic power of the forest is wrapped in the aura of purple electricity, flowing directly to the mountain gate along with the mountain wind.
The bell rang three times on the mountainside, and a dozen disciples rushed out from the palace and pavilions. They were all in the Qi refining period, with panic written on their faces.
A middle-aged man who looked like a disciple in charge ran to the mountain gate, looked up, and his legs became weak.
"Quick! Activate the sect formation!"
Formation patterns lit up from under the foundation of the mountain gate and spread toward the three peaks.
The lightning strike stone on the stone archway buzzed and vibrated. It was the lightning strike stone that was said to have only 30% of its power left.
Lin Ye stood fifty steps in front of the mountain gate, looking down at the formation patterns spreading on the ground.
A purple thunder pillar fell from the sky and hit the stone archway.
The lines of the century-old magic circle collapsed and shattered all the way to the mountainside. The spiritual light flickered for a few times and then went out.
The sect's great formation is gone.
Lin Ye stepped up the steps.
Behind him, the fangs and the black wolf monsters spread out in a fan shape, sealing off all escape routes between the three peaks.
The rest, there's not much to say.
Disciples in the Qi refining stage are not even qualified to resist. None of them ran away, and the black wolves blocked all the main roads.
Half an hour later, Hengyun Mountain changed owners.
Jianfan ran over with a roster of Qinghe Sect disciples from the Sutra Pavilion in his mouth, with dust on his nose.
"Your Majesty, there are a large number of monsters hidden in the dense forests and underground caves in the three peaks of Hengyun Mountain."
"Some are spirit beasts that were captured and signed a blood contract before. The blood contract was broken when the owner died, and some are local wild monsters in Hengyun Mountain."
"A rough estimate is that there are no less than three hundred animals. It is estimated that there are many female animals. Their physical condition needs to be carefully investigated."
Lin Ye's ears perked up.
This was a much bigger gain than expected. But Hengyun Mountain is four hundred miles away from Heifeng Mountain and is beyond reach.
"You stay, and the monsters in Hengyun Mountain will be under your control from now on."
"The female beast drinks the spirit spring water every three days according to the rules. If there is no spirit spring here, it will be replaced by the spring hole seeping out of the spirit veins."
"The collected monsters follow the rules of Black Wind Mountain. They are not allowed to hurt human children. Violators will be dealt with directly."
Fang's legs straightened.
"Subordinates take orders!"
